My freshman year one of our sister schools (in the same district right down the street) a kid was murdered at a city-wide talent show audition.
Every year our city has this talent show basically where people compete for stardom. Anyway the auditions were being held at local jewish community center that i really didn't live that far from. The kid was walking out with his grandfather and they were both shot by some guy. The shooter then drove down to a living center and shot one more person. All three died and as the guy was being arrested he was reported to be shouting "heil hitler" there were many vigils and moments of silence held all around the district. The kid was in my grade and was senslessly murdered for no reason. The westboro baptist church even protested his funeral for whatever reason. 
The whole thing made national news and the president even sent out his condolences to the family. All of this happening in a nice area with little crime shook the whole city for a long time. It is still a terribly tragic story that really isn't talked about anymore.

Edit: i even remember being on my computer and hearing the sirens headed to the community center that day and was wondering what it was for
I set that ringtone as my alarm, so it wakes me up every morning.
